name: App switcher
oneLiner: the app on screen shrinks out of full frame into a card while the other open apps fan out from behind it, each with its glyph and name above, the row slides until the brand's card is centred, a tap ripples on it and it grows back to fill the whole frame with the brand's screen in a slow push
say: when the speaker says they jump between apps all day or that one tool replaced the rest ('I used to switch between five apps, now I just open this one'): the cards fan out on 'five apps', the tap lands on 'this one' and the cut back sits on the full screen
